Step:  
09-10-1101 is October 9, 1101.  
34 weeks = 34 × 7 = 238 days.  
Add 1 more day → 239 days before.  

239 days before Oct 9, 1101:  
October has 31 days.  
Go back 9 days into September → Sept 30 (1 day back), Sept 29 (2), …, Sept 21 (10 days back from Oct 9). That’s 9 days subtracted.  
Remaining: 239 − 9 = 230 days earlier.  

From Sept 21, 1101:  
September has 30 days, so Aug 22 is 30 days before Sept 21 (since Sept 21 → Aug 22 = 30 days).  
230 − 30 = 200 days earlier from Aug 22.  

200 days before Aug 22, 1101:  
July has 31 days → back 31 days to July 22 (200 − 31 = 169).  
June has 30 days → back to June 22 (169 − 30 = 139).  
May has 31 days → back to May 22 (139 − 31 = 108).  
April has 30 days → back to April 22 (108 − 30 = 78).  
March has 31 days → back to March 22 (78 − 31 = 47).  
February in 1101 (not leap year, 1101 not divisible by 4) has 28 days → back to Jan 25 (47 − 28 = 19).  
From Jan 25, 1101, go back 19 more days → Jan 6, 1101.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1101-01-06
